pages.title: Rules
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)PvP is on$() and there are $(bold)no land claims$(). Pick your spot with care, keep valuables close, and settle things like adults.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Die and your items wait in a grave$() where you fell. Only you can open it (a teammate can with your permission).$(br)$(li)$(bold)No waystones, no teleports.$() You travel by train, airship, horse and happy ghast, so the rail network matters. Nether portals are linked properly (a portal always leads back where it came from).$(br)$(li)$(bold)The launcher decides the mods.$() Your own extras go in its Mods tab.

pages.title: What's different from vanilla
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Create is the spine.$() Every stage of progress runs through Create machines; other mods feed it (ore veins, crops, coins) or give it a reason to exist (structures, an economy, airships).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Terrain:$() Terralith, Regions Unexplored and Nullscape rework the Overworld and the End, with new trees and woods.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Structures:$() When Dungeons Arise, YUNG's structures, Create-themed ruins and towns. Loot chests are per player (Lootr), so nobody gets beaten to one.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Ore veins:$() Create Ore Excavation adds infinite veins you find with a prospector and drill with Create

machines.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Economy:$() Numismatics coins pay for quests and missions and buy from other players' vendors.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Skills:$() RuneScape-style levels gate weapons, tools and armour and make you stronger. See $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)Skills$(/l).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Maps:$() Xaero's minimap and world map, without mob radar or cave maps (fair play).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Voice:$() proximity voice chat. Press $(bold)V$() for its settings; $(bold)O$() mutes your microphone.

pages.title: Weekly missions
pages.text: Brassworks Missions posts a set of Create-flavoured missions every week (ESC → Missions, or $(bold)H$()). They pay coins and quest XP.
